body.p: Amazon KDPrequirementsAmazon Kindle Direct Publishing is the largest e-book distribution platform. When you set epub.platform=kdp, the plugin automatically applies all KDP-specific requirements:

ul.li: NCX generation — the toc.ncx file is forced regardless of epub.generate.ncx, because some Kindle devices still rely on it for navigation
OPF guide element — the deprecated <guide> element is added to the OPF, with reference entries for cover, title page, TOC, text start, copyright, and glossary
Platform CSS — epub-platform-kdp.css is included, adjusting image widths, margins, and other rendering for Kindle devices
Cover image validation — the plugin emits a warning if the cover image is SVG (Kindle does not support SVG covers)

section.title: KDP Cover Requirements
section.p: Amazon has specific cover imageKDP requirementscover image requirements:

ul.li: File format: JPEG (preferred) — SVG is not supported
Color space: RGB only (CMYK not supported)
Must include title and author name
Must not include spine, barcode, back cover, or pricing

section.title: KDP Metadata Requirements
section.p: For a complete KDP submission, ensure your bookmap includes:

ul.li: ISBN-13 — in <bookid>/<isbn> (required for paperback, recommended for eBook)
BISAC codes — at least two, for Amazon category placement
Keywords — up to seven keyword phrases for discoverability
Publisher — your imprint or publisher name

section.title: Example KDP Build Command
section.codeblock: dita --input=my-novel.ditamap --format=epub3 \ -Depub.platform=kdp \ -Depub.theme=fiction \ -Depub.cover.image=cover-kdp.jpg \ -Depub.series.name="My Series" \ -Depub.series.position=1 \ -Depub.bisac.codes=FIC028080,FIC031080 \ -Depub.publisher="My Press" \ -Depub.rights="Copyright 2026 Author Name. All rights reserved." \ -Depub.drop.caps=yes
